page.title: Tools
page.description: What the AI can do besides answering: search the web, work with files, and use the apps and services you add.
page.allDescription: Every tool, built in or added. Turn one off here to keep it out of every chat.

video.title: Video generation
video.unsupported: Videos can't be made on this computer: {{reason}}.
video.ready: Ask for a short clip, or attach an image and ask to bring it to life. Clips are made on this computer with {{model}} and take several minutes; nothing is sent anywhere.
video.notSetUp: Video generation isn't set up yet. Setup downloads stable-diffusion.cpp from GitHub, if image generation hasn't, and a video model from Hugging Face; after that, clips are made on this computer, offline.
video.makesAndEdits: · makes clips, and brings images to life

images.title: Image generation
images.unsupported: Images can't be made on this computer: {{reason}}.
images.ready: Ask for an image, or attach one and ask for a change. Images are made on this computer with {{model}}; nothing is sent anywhere.
images.notSetUp: Image generation isn't set up yet. Setup downloads stable-diffusion.cpp from GitHub and a model from Hugging Face; after that, images are made on this computer, offline.

sources.title: Tool sources
sources.description: Apps and services the AI can use, from the gallery or any MCP server. Ones on this computer start when a tool is needed and stop when idle.
sources.empty: No tool sources yet. Add Notion, Linear, a browser, folders on this computer, or any MCP server — most take one click.
sources.alwaysOfferHelp: Normally it is offered when a message mentions it or its subject. Turn on for tools you want always at hand.
sources.sampling: Let it ask your AI for help
sources.samplingHelp: Some servers ask the AI to summarize or write as part of a tool. It uses a model on your computers.
sources.keywords: Words that mean a message is about it
sources.name: Name
sources.stored: Stored ({{value}}). Leave blank to keep it.

add.title: Add tools
add.description: Tool sources use the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the standard most AI apps share. Their tools work in every chat and automation. Reading is allowed; anything that changes something asks you first.
add.startingLocal: Starting it and listing its tools. The first start downloads it, which can take a minute.
add.needsSignIn: <name>{{name}}</name> needs you to sign in. Finish in the window that opened; its tools appear here when you are done.
add.readyNoTools: <name>{{name}}</name> is ready with 0 tools. Ask about it in chat.
add.readyReads_one: <name>{{name}}</name> is ready with {{count}} tool: {{reads}} that read. Ask about it in chat.
add.readyReads_other: <name>{{name}}</name> is ready with {{count}} tools: {{reads}} that read. Ask about it in chat.
add.readyChanges_one: <name>{{name}}</name> is ready with {{count}} tool: {{reads}} that read, and {{changes}} that change things and ask you first. Ask about it in chat.
add.readyChanges_other: <name>{{name}}</name> is ready with {{count}} tools: {{reads}} that read, and {{changes}} that change things and ask you first. Ask about it in chat.
add.signInNote: A window opens for you to sign in to {{name}} and choose what Toskar may use. Your sign-in stays on this computer.
add.missing: This runs on this computer and needs {{runtime}}, which is not installed.
add.installNode: Install Node.js from nodejs.org (or run brew install node), then add it.
add.installUv: Install uv from docs.astral.sh/uv (or run brew install uv), then add it.
add.installDocker: Install and start <go>Docker Desktop</go>, then add it.
add.pasteLabel: Paste what a server's instructions say: its JSON settings for any app, its web address, or the command that runs it.
add.name: Name
add.fillIn: Fill in what the instructions left for you to add:
add.secretsKept: Secrets are kept on this computer, outside the AI's view.
add.noneFound: No MCP servers were found in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, or LM Studio on this computer.
add.appsIntro: Servers you already set up in other apps. Adding one copies its settings; its secrets go straight to Toskar's secret store.
add.clientIdHint: (only if the service gave you one)
add.keptHere: Keys, tokens, passwords, and headers are kept on this computer, outside the AI's view.
